protocol: Same initial neural/free physical banks, carrier, centered residual scale and architecture as prior trial. REUSE prior 64-record normalization cache as optimizer control (not validation). Raw SR on 32 fresh Born centers per attempt, then exactly13 amplitude-only FS matching probes on separate fixed-Q control. One full-H control candidate per attempt; no energy line search or audit-driven extension. Reject if step FS>.01, carrier FS>.04, control E exceeds carrier or parent, variance exceeds1.1 carrier, or weight ESS<.6. Fixed8 attempts per arm even on rejection. All learned parameters still jointly eligible. Accepted-state plus random stream/control products checkpointed. No extra heads/parameters/size or ED.
cost_boundary: Per arm256 training centers plus512 control candidate centers. Cache immutable reference H products/connection plans on the control set; count reference preparation separately, never claim identical H cost to the previous unprotected run. Both arms have the same control and full-H budgets. All216 bonds/432 images retained. No division by residual amplitudes.
audit_boundary: Final parameters sealed before fresh128-record common defensive-Q audit at a new seed, never reuse the previous audit as untouched. Energy acceptance on reused controls is not proof of improvement. Report actual nonzero accepted updates, any collapse to carrier, paired energy/variance, physical distance and cost. No production/GPU release or post-audit continuation.
